segments.name: Fresh install and the Christmas interstitial (Free, signed out)
segments.note: Clean install of the given APK (pm clear or reinstall, logs pulled first; Stage file stays in /sdcard/cyberlink/PDR/). The interstitial shows once a day (Q-4): every row that needs it showing again gets a fresh first launch (pm clear, then GDPR 「Get Started」) unless a phone-date step is shown to bring it back. segments.name: Interstitial languages (27, Christmas)
segments.note: Each row: `launch --lang <code>` (per-app language, Android 13) and the interstitial on a first launch (pm clear first, as in R1-a). Compare with the 多國文案 sheet text in the row; 「<xx>」 and 「<monthly price>」 are the store's values (this account's store; record which). End with `locale reset`.

segments.name: Launcher, Mine and IAP (Free)
segments.note: Free account (signed in if a row needs it). Opening a Google Play panel is fine; never subscribe or buy here. US prices (TC-100, TC-101) need the Play country set to US in Play Billing Lab; TC-111 – TC-113 set India / Indonesia / Philippines there (Q-17); restore the country after. Dark/light (TC-083 / TC-084), display size (TC-143) and rotation (TC-144 – TC-146) are phone settings the run sets and restores; landscape rows are Blocked test-data only if the app stays portrait on this phone. TC-134 / TC-135 / TC-142 need a Free balance below the Image to Video (Custom) price.

segments.name: Purchases and Pro rows
segments.note: Test purchases only when the Google Play sheet shows a test purchase (license tester, 「Test card, always approves」); a real payment method stops for the user (AGENTS.md). TC-148 (500 pack, Free) first, then TC-147 makes the account Pro. Paid low-balance rows (TC-132, TC-133, TC-141) before the credit purchases; TC-140 after TC-149 (enough credits). TC-150 (Auto Pass) before TC-126. TC-151: steps 1–2 only (Christmas); step 3 needs the New Year RD date. TC-114 needs app language 日本語 and Play country Japan (Play Billing Lab), restored after.
